title: Organization root registration, org-root-registration/1 (DEC-0131)
description: What the owner's Fabric POSTs to {issuer}/fabric/membership/v1/{org}/root before the first key set (DEC-0131 OX-2): the membership root's public half and the owner's signing credential for this organization, authorised by the one-time claim the server showed the owner's signed-in account (at most 15 minutes old). The server then drafts revision 1 with them; the root's signature over that set is the proof the sender holds the root. docs/specification/membership.md.

root.description: The root as members pin it (OM-2).

administrator.description: The owner's signing passkey registered for this organization alone (OM-3), which the server lists as the first set's administrator.

claim.description: The one-time claim, a bearer secret: 32 random bytes, base64url, that the server showed the owner on its signed-in page for this organization and the owner gave their Fabric. Never in a URL or a link (FAC-SEM-143's rule); used up only by a registration the server accepts.
